summary: Post-repair clock skew causing Intune device attestation failures and provisioning stalls
description:
Issue summary: Following depot repair and battery replacement, a subset of returned laptops enter a provisioning failure state during Autopilot/Intune enrollment. Devices repeatedly fail device attestation and drop into BitLocker recovery or are marked noncompliant, blocking automated post-provisioning tasks.

Impact: 18 devices in the NY depot cohort; customers' engineers and SREs experienced delays in replacing hardware and reprovisioning. Automated fleet reimage pipeline blocked for affected serial batches.

Environment: Production autopilot flow, us-east, affected builds include latest corporate image (2026-02-15), devices repaired at vendor depot (third-party).
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Receive device from depot after NVMe swap / RTC battery replacement.
2) Boot to OOBE / Autopilot flow with company network (corp-wifi with DHCP).
3) Device attempts Autopilot + Intune attestation.
4) Observe attestation failure, event ID 1001 in provisioning logs and Windows falls back to local account or BitLocker recovery.

Repro rate: ~90% for devices repaired during 2026-03-05 – 2026-03-08 depot batch.
logs:
[ProvisioningAgent] 2026-03-10T09:12:03Z ERROR Attestation failed: time-drift-exceeds-threshold (delta=372s)
[WinSVC] 2026-03-10T09:12:04Z WARN TimeService not synchronized, NtpClient returned error 0x80072ee7
[Intune] 2026-03-10T09:12:05Z INFO Device attestation rejected - TPM PCR time structure mismatch
[BitLocker] 2026-03-10T09:12:10Z CRITICAL Recovery triggered: PCR0 mismatch
DHCP lease details: option 42 not set; network NTP server missing
investigation_notes:
Initial triage (2026-03-10): Support confirmed correlation with depot repairs (same vendor batch). Devices showed RTC drift of several minutes on first boot. BIOS reported hardware clock behind wall time.

Hypothesis 1: Depot replacement procedure omitted re-sync of firmware RTC after battery install, leaving CMOS clock skewed. This causes measured PCR values tied to system boot time to diverge from expected values during Azure/Intune attestation.

Hypothesis 2: Corporate network DHCP scope removed option 42 (NTP) briefly on 2026-03-05 due to DHCP server config change; combined with disabled Windows Time Service (policy conflict from a scheduled baseline) devices could not auto-correct clock before attestation step.

Data points: Serial range affected: 7D0A0000 - 7D0A0111. Timedatectl on a repro device showed RTC=2026-03-05T02:01:12 whereas wallclock=2026-03-10T09:20:00. Depot image logs show battery replacement ticket IDs. Linked to INT-9276 (previous RTC attestation investigation).

Temporary mitigation tested: manual time sync via admin network console (w32tm /resync) allows attestation to succeed and provisioning continues. Verified on 3 devices.

Root cause: Combination of depot RTC left unsynced after battery swap and a transient removal of DHCP NTP option in corp network prevented automatic correction prior to attestation window. TPM PCRs used by attestation include time-related measurements causing the mismatch.
comments: Support (Jordan Lee) 2026-03-10: Customer-facing depot reported 12 returns failing autopilot. Collected serials, repro’d one device in office lab.
Depot Tech (Marta Gomez) 2026-03-10: Confirmed RTC battery replaced on all serials in batch; repair checklist item 'sync RTC' not ticked for these tickets.

SRE (Ravi Patel) 2026-03-11: Observed DHCP config change on 2026-03-05 removing option 42 during maintenance window — reverted. Correlated with affected serial range.
Action: re-enable DHCP option 42 and confirm NTP service reachable from corp network.

Engineering (Priya Kapoor) 2026-03-11: Provisioning agent updated to add a pre-attestation NTP check and an NTP resync attempt (w32tm /config /syncfromflags:manual) before starting attestation flow. PR linked.
Support (Jordan Lee) 2026-03-12: Verified fix on 18 affected devices; all progressed past attestation and completed autopilot successfully.
resolution_notes:
Workaround applied: Depot instructed to run 'timedatectl set-ntp true && timedatectl set-timezone UTC' and connect repaired units to a staging network with reachable NTP prior to sealing. In prod: DHCP option 42 restored and monitoring alert added to detect missing NTP servers.

Permanent fixes: 1) Provisioning agent change merged and rolled (PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/provisioning-agent/pull/472) to perform NTP sanity check and force a one-time resync before attestation. 2) Depot SOP updated to include an RTC resync step and checklist enforcement. 3) Fleet health dashboard updated to surface devices reporting time skew > 60s.

Postmortem actions: create a short runbook for 'attestation-time-skew' (confluence page created). Outreach: notified depot vendor and internal procurement for process compliance. Ticket closed after verification on 2026-03-12.
follow_up_items: SOP: Depot RTC resync step added (owner: Depot Ops)
Monitoring: Alert for DHCP option 42 removal (owner: SRE)
Engineering: Backfill unit tests for pre-attestation time sync (owner: Provisioning Team)
